get_cfg: get a copy of the default detectron2 CfgNode config instance
set_global_cfg: set the global config to a given CfgNode for access anywhere in code
CfgNode_merge_from_file: merge configuration values from a YAML file into a CfgNode with versioning support
CfgNode_dump: dump a CfgNode config object to a YAML string representation
configurable_decorator: decorate a class init or function to accept a CfgNode via from_config
